item.title: What Happened to Jasmine Star?
item.description: The mid-2000s were a great time for many budding photographers. While some achieved immense fame, others saw their flair fade away in a short period. For instance, Eric Kim, a renowned street photographer, is now working with Cryptocurrency. Another notable name to join this list is Jasmine Star, a former top-notch wedding photographer who is no longer pursuing the business. So, what exactly happened to the image-maker to move her paths 180 degrees?

item.title: Before Macro Lenses Existed, This Photographer Shot a Snowflake
item.description: Snowfall is one of the most magical experiences of all time. The white, rain-covered streets turn every day events into a scene from a movie. In fact, anyone who has seen snow for the first time can attest to what a truly humbling experience it is. However, while we continue to marvel at this little natural phenomenon, there is one photographer who has taken it a step further: documenting individual snowflakes. How did he achieve this in the 20th century? Well, let's dive in.

item.title: Photographers: It’s Time to Give Your Mind a Rest
item.description: Dear photographers: it's time to put the camera down for a bit. You don't need to live behind your lens all the time and you need to realize that too much time with a camera can feel like a job that you don't want. So you need to give it a break. But this goes far beyond the camera. It's time for a visual detox. Visual media is copying one another way too much. And it's time for originality to shine.
